Director Martin Scorsese exposes the fascinating, mysterious, and violent underworld of New York's Mafia families through the life of insider Henry Hill.

When the mob murders policeman Truman Gates' younger brother, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

In this neo-noir crime film, an undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in New York City's Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia, which is now led by two of his childhood friends (Gary Oldman and Ed Harris).
